senses.gloss: f. (קָמַץ) taking a fistful of the meal-offering.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 9a:10">Men. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מק׳ ואילך מצות כהונה</he> all the manipulations from the taking of the fistful and onward are priestly functions.
Meg. 16ᵃ הלכות ק׳ the rules concerning ḳ’mitsah; a. fr.—
Men. 11ᵃ; Keth. 5ᵇ זו ק׳ this (the third finger) is used for ḳ.— Pl. קְמִיצוֹת.
<cite ref="Menachot 18b:10">Men. 18ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 2:7">Tosef. Dem. II, 7</cite>; a. fr.
